title: User-caused token failures must be swallowed, not requeued
answers: why doesn't a repo retry after GitHub App is uninstalled
how should user-caused git sync errors be handled in reconcile
token generation fails because permissions revoked, what should happen
repository stuck reconciling due to lost access
body: In RepositoryController.process (pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/controller/repository.go), when generateRepositoryToken fails and rc.isUserCaused(err) is true (classifyTokenErrorCause == reconcileCauseUser: app uninstalled, permissions revoked, installation gone, repository not selected), the function must append status patches via tokenFailurePatchOps, set swallowedErr/swallowedPhase = err, reconcilePhaseToken, and return nil instead of err. Returning the error here would requeue forever and page on-call for something only the customer can fix. Non-user-caused token errors must still be returned normally.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/controller/repository.go RepositoryController.process, and any new user-caused error path added there
